feature: Collection surfaces: the place head and its tabs
note: PR 3 of the collection surfaces line (Call 4, R2 §Q1). One `CollectionPlaceHead` heads all three routes, so the sheet photographs each of them at the four widths the audit names: 360 and 390 for the phone, 768 for the narrowest md frame, and 1300. Rows only, no clicks: each tab is a plain link, so a route's own URL is the state the tab lands on. The empty-collection branch is not a row, because neither fixture account is empty; `collection-place-head.test.tsx` pins it, and `probe:collection-tabs` measures the strip's position on every route here.

shares.note: The shared `(list)/layout.tsx` renders the head once for all three routes, so each row's `view` is that layout rather than its own page.
